correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the full rational tensor kernel, rules out antipodal and prime-polygon proper subrelations, proves minimality of each checkerboard via the additive matrix constraint, derives a universal parity-paired cycle bound, and constructs matching examples using two deleted edges. Exhaustive integer verifier checks 16,992 small checkerboards with exact rational relation tests; finite checks are not the general proof.
